messages.text:
I’ll continue from the checkpoint by fixing the two remaining real browser failures rather than weakening the tests: the preview action must open the dialog, and the mobile dock must stay above gallery media.

I’ll inspect the current component/CSS and Playwright context, then patch the smallest surface and rerun all gates.

commands.preview: rg -n "Preview|onPreview|Lightbox|dialog|dock|imageButton|tile|gallery" src/components src/routes src/styles src/tests/e2e package.json playwright.config.ts

event.stopPropagation()}>
{prompt.model} / {prompt.category}

{prompt.title}

{prompt.description}

{prompt.rating.toFixed(1)} rating{prompt.sold.toLocaleString()} sold{prompt.creator}
{free ? 'Free' : `$${prompt.price}`}
) }
